outcome: admission to special care baby unit
cohort: 363 infants of diabetic mothers (IDMs) admitted to the postnatal ward of a tertiary care hospital in Bangladesh.
finding: Hypoglycemia developed in 38.3% of IDMs, with a majority (68%) occurring at 2 hours of age and most (85%) within 6 hours of birth; longer duration of maternal diabetes and large for gestational age were associated with hypoglycemia.
